book.name: MARK
book.title: Rongamwahu me Ntingdier sang rehn MARK

content: Duwen Padahk en mehn Mahs ako
Parisi kei oh sounkawehwehn Kosonnedo kei me patohdo sang Serusalem ahpw pokonpene rehn Sises.
Re tehkada duwen ekei sapwellime tohnpadahk ko ar kin iang sak ni peh samin—ni ar sohte kin omwiomw nin duwen tiahk me Parisi ko kin nda aramas koaros en kin wia.
(Pwe Parisi ko, pil mehn Suhs koaros, re kin daur tiahk me re kin ale sang rehn mehn Suhs en kawa ko: iei me re sohte kin mwenge ma re sohte pahn omwiomw mahs duwen tiahk kedeudeu en mehn kawa ko.

Re sohte kin kang mehkot me kin wisikdo sang wasahn netinet kan, ma re sohte kin widen mahs. Re pil kin wia tiahk tohto me re ale sang rehn mehn kawa ko: duwehte wiepen widen kep, widen dahl, oh widen dahl prahs oh peht kan.)

Parisi ko oh sounkawehwehn Kosonnedo ko eri kalelapak rehn Sises, patohwanohng, “Maing, dahme sapwellimomwi tohnpadahk kan sohte kin iangki kapwaiada tiahk kedeudeu en samatail mehn kawa ko, ni ar kin iangete mwenge sohte omwiomw mahs?”
A Sises ketin sapeng irail, mahsanih, “Mehlelete me Aiseia me pwung ni eh kohpadahr duwen amwail mwalaunen, duwen me ntingdiero:

content.text: ‘Koht mahsanih, aramas pwukat kin kahkahkin ie ni arail lokaia,
a kapehdirail kan inenen dohsang ie.
Sohte katepen ar kin kaudokiong ie,
pwe re kin padahkihweite kosonned en aramas dene e pwilisang rehn Koht!’”

content: E ahpw pil mahsanih, “Kumwail kin kesehla kosonned en Koht, oh kin nsenohkihte kapwaiada tiahk kedeudeu en aramas akan.”
E ahpw pil ketin usehlahte, mahsanih, “Mehlel, pwe kumwail kin kauwehla kosonned en Koht, pwe kumwail en apwalih mwahu pein amwail tiahk kan.
Pwe Moses koasoanehdi, mahsanih, ‘Ke en kahkahki semomw oh inomw,’ oh ‘Mehmen me pahn lahlahwe seme de ine, e pahn kamakamala.’
A kumwail kin uhd padahkihwei, ‘Ma aramas emen ahneki mehkot me e kak sewesehki seme oh ine, e ahpw nda, “Korpan met” (me wehwehki sapwellimen Koht,)
dene e solahr ahneki pwukoahn sewese seme oh ine.’
Eri, ih duwen amwail kin kauwehla mahsen en Koht ni amwail kin padahkihong meteikan tiahk kan me kumwail kin pein wiahda. Oh pil mie soangen tiahk tohto me rasehng met, me kumwail kin wiewia.”
Dahme kin Kasaminehla Aramas
Sises eri pil ketin malipepene pokono oh mahsanihong irail, “Kumwail koaros rong ie mwahu oh medemedewe mwahu met.
Sohte mehkot mehn likin aramas me kin kohlong loale, kin kasaminehla. Pwe mehkan me kin kohieisang loale, iei ih me kin kasaminehla aramas.
(Kumwail rong ma mie salengamwail mehn rong wasa!”)
Ni eh ketiketla sang rehn aramas ako oh ketilong nan ihmwo, sapwellime tohnpadahk ko ahpw kalelapak reh wehwehn karasaras pwoatet.
Ih eri mahsanihong irail, “Dah, kumwail sohte loalokongsang aramas teikan? Kumwail sehse me sohte mehkot mehn likin aramas me kin kohlong loale, kin kak kasaminehla,

pwehki eh sohte kin kohla nan mohngiong, pwe nan eh mpweien mwenge, wasa e kin kohsang ie oh kohla likin paliwere.” (Ni eh ketin mahsanih met, Sises ketin kadehdehda duwen soangen mwenge koaros, eh mwahu ong aramas.)
Ih eri pil mahsanih, “Me kin kohda sang loalen aramas, iei ih me kin kasaminehla aramas.
Pwe sang loalen aramas, sang nan eh mohngiong, me lamalam suwed kan kin kohda sang ie, me kin kahrehiong nan dipen tiahk suwed, pirap, kamaramas,
kamwahl, noahrok, oh wia soahng suwed teikan koaros; piht, sarsuwed, peirin, lahlahwe, aklapalap oh seukautih—
soahng suwed pwukat koaros kin tepisang loalen aramas, oh ih me kin kasaminehla aramas.”
En Lih emen eh Pwoson
Sises eri ketiketla sang wasao, ketiketlahng nan wehin Dair. E ahpw ketilong nan ihmw ehu oh sohte kupwurki aramas akan en ese me e ketiket wasao; ahpw e sohte kak rirla.
Pwe lih emen me ngehn saut tiadahr pohn nah kisin serepein kis ahpw esehda me e ketiket wasao, e ahpw pedolongete nan ihmwo poaridiong mwohn aluweluwe ko.
Ih lihen liki men, e ipwidi Penisia nan wehin Siria. Ih eri peki rehn Sises en ketin kausasang ngehn suwedo rehn nah kisin serepeino.
Sises eri ketin sapeng, mahsanih, “Kitail kamwenge mahs seri kan, pwe e sohte konehng ale kenen seri kan oh kesehdiong kidi kan.”
Liho ahpw sapeng, patohwan, “Mehlel Maing, ahpw kisin kidi kan pil kin iang tungoale mweremweren en seri kan ar tungoal pahn tehpel kan!”
Sises eri ketin sapeng, mahsanih, “Pwehki duwen omw pasapengen, ukuwei ni imwomwo; pwe ngehn suwedo kohsangehr rehn noumw kisin serepeino!”
Liho eri pwurala ni imweo oh diarada me nah kisin serepeino wie wonohn nan dewe; a ngehn suwedo kohieisangehr.
Sises ketin Kakehlahda Ohl Salengepon oh Lohteng men
Sises eri ketiketla sang sapwen Dair, e ahpw ketin keid ni keilen Saidon, ketilahng Lehen Kalili, oh kotehla wehin Dekapolis.
Aramas ekei ahpw kahredohng reh ohl salengepon oh lohteng men, oh peki en ketikidahng lime kan powe.
Sises eri kahrehsang ohlo nan pokono, e ahpw ketikihlong nan pwoaren salenge ko sapwellime rekileng ko oh ketiki pilen doauese, oh doahkehki lowen ohlo.
Sises eri mahsendalahng nanleng oh ketin asmoamoarada, e ahpw mahsanihong ohlo, “Eppada,” me wehwehki “Wahsekpeseng!”
Ni ahnsowohte pwoaren salengen ohl pa wahsekpeseng oh selin loweo pa sapwedekda; ih eri tapihada lokaiahda.
Sises eri ketin kalikiraildi koaros re dehpa ndaiong emen mehkotet. A duwen uwen kehkehlik kehlail me e ketin wiahiong irail, ih duwen ar kehlail en lohkiseli manaman wet.

Irail koaros me iang rong wiepen manaman wet, re ahpw malamalawangkihla oh ndinda, “Wiepen nin lime kan me inenen mwahu mehlel! Pwe e kin kupwure pwe me salengepon kan en rongada wasa oh kin ketin kalokaiahda me lohteng kan!”
